subject.title: [do not merge] refactor: flip sessions and transcripts to sqlite storage

question: Should OpenClaw continue this branch as the one-way SQLite session/transcript cutover, including removal of the active file-backed Plugin SDK APIs, after porting the newer durable continuation contract?
rationale: Code review can identify the required integration work, but only maintainers can accept the permanent storage and public Plugin SDK compatibility boundary or choose to narrow or replace the migration.

options.title: Continue the cutover
options.body: Rebase and port the current-main continuation invariants, retain the one-way SQLite and SDK cleanup direction, and require complete upgrade proof before merge.

options.title: Narrow the migration
options.body: Keep SQLite runtime storage but preserve or version selected public SDK compatibility surfaces until a separately approved breaking release.

options.title: Pause and replace
options.body: Close this implementation lane and design a smaller successor series if the combined storage, SDK, migration, and channel blast radius is no longer reviewable.

recommendation.title: Continue the cutover
recommendation.body: Rebase and port the current-main continuation invariants, retain the one-way SQLite and SDK cleanup direction, and require complete upgrade proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: He merged and substantially shaped the current-main continuation contract that must be reconciled with the storage direction.
